text.name: Golden Goose
text.description:
{Golden Goose}

In addition to component effect when equipped, the Golden Goose increases your income by 4750 gold per day.
text.event: You wander on an abandoned house of a collector in search for a camp place. Most of the goods were long stolen by the marauders, but you were able to find a couple of dusty pet statues. You vaguely recognize one of them. You rub the dust off one of them, and discover a golden goose.

text.name: Pendant of Reflection
text.description:
{Pendant of Reflection}

In addition to component effect this item increases your chance to resist a hostile spell by 20%.
text.event: Soldiers approach you with talks about a miracle. You are intrigued and follow them. You see a strange sight indeed; a wanderer sitting on top of the fire trap, without any harm. You offer him money in exchange for the secret, but he laughs and vanishes in the air. You see a strange pendant left in the middle of the trap.

text.name: Ring of Elements
text.description:
{Ring of Elements}

When equipped, the Ring of Elements allows you to summon Elementals of all types. It also allows you to summon Elementals of different types during combat.
